description: The plot illustrates the relationship between TFLOPs and Loss Ratio for different configurations of SepLLM and a baseline Vanilla model. The x-axis represents TFLOPs on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick labels at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis represents the Loss Ratio as a percentage on a linear scale, ranging from 94 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 1. The plot includes five lines representing different models: Vanilla (purple, solid line, no markers), SepLLM (n=64) (orange, dashed line, triangle markers), SepLLM (n=128) (blue, dashed line, square markers), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green, dashed line, diamond markers), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red, dashed line, circle markers). The Vanilla line remains steady at 100% across the x-axis. The SepLLM (n=64) line starts at approximately 98.2% at 1e7 TFLOPs and increases to around 99.7% at 3e8 TFLOPs before slightly decreasing to about 99.4% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The SepLLM (n=128) line begins at around 97.2% at 1e7 TFLOPs and rises to nearly 100% at 3e8 TFLOPs, then drops to approximately 99.4% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The SepLLM (n=64, H) line starts at about 97.5% at 1e7 TFLOPs, reaches a peak of around 100.1% at 3e8 TFLOPs, and then decreases to approximately 99.6% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The SepLLM (n=64, H/T) line begins at around 94% at 1e7 TFLOPs, increases to about 99% at 3e8 TFLOPs, and then remains relatively stable, ending at approximately 98.8% at 9e8 TFLOPs.
